Detect document type.description: Tika as a content analysis framework, it can extract text or metadata. But before extraction, it must first identify what kind of file it is dealing with. This is necessary because different formats require different parsers. Tika can detect multiple document types, such as pdf, word, xml, and more. For this it uses different techniques for document types detection. Your task is to explore the architectural design decisions that achieve document type detection in Apache Tika.

question1.description: What are the architectural components and connectors in Apache Tika that achieves document type detection? Briefly name and describe each component, determine their type (physical or logical), determine  how they are connected, and how they achieve the requirements.

question2.description: What solutions (e.g., patterns or tactics) are implemented to support quality attributes in Apache Tika for achieving document type detection? Mention the considered quality attributes and describe the solutions applied, and how they achieve the requirements.

question3.description: Which tools and technologies are integrated to handle Apache Tika document type detection? Mention the technologies and tools, their associated components, rationale, and how they achieve the requirements.

Extensibility requirement.description: Tika as a content analysis framework needs to parse text from documents with different formats. However, new document types appear constantly. Therefore, Apache Tika needs to support the extensibility of its type detector and parser. Your task is to explore the architectural design decisions that achieve the extensibility requirements in Apache Tika.

question1.description: What are the architectural components and connectors in Apache Tika that support (affect) its extensibility requirement for its detector and parser? Briefly name and describe each component, determine their type (physical or logical), determine  how they are connected, and how they achieve the requirements.

question2.description: What solutions (e.g., patterns or tactics) are implemented to support the extensibility quality attribute in Apache Tika for its detector and parser? Mention the considered quality attributes and describe the solutions applied, and how they achieve the requirements.

question3.description: Which tools and technologies are integrated to achieve its extensibility quality attribute in Apache Tika for its detector and parser? Mention the technologies and tools, their associated components, rationale, and how they achieve the requirements.

Parse document.description: Tika as a content analysis framework can parse text from a document. Depending on the type of the document, several parsers are considered. Your task is to explore the architectural design decisions that achieve the extraction of text and metadata from a document in Apache Tika.

question1.description: What are the architectural components and connectors in Apache Tika that achieves parsing documents? Briefly name and describe each component, determine their type (physical or logical), determine  how they are connected, and how they achieve the requirements.

question2.description: What solutions (e.g., patterns or tactics) are implemented to support quality attributes in Apache Tika to achieve parsing documents? Mention the considered quality attributes and describe the solutions applied, and how they achieve the requirements.

question3.description: Which tools and technologies are integrated to achieve parsing documents in Apache Tika? Mention the technologies and tools, their associated components, rationale, and how they achieve the requirements.

Performance requirement.description: The performance of Tika is critical to parse documents in a short time period and with less memory. This is important as Tika is used in developing search engines that require fast responses. Your task is to explore the architectural design decisions that achieve the performance requirements in Apache Tika.

question1.description: What are the architectural components and connectors in Apache Tika that support its performance requirement for parsing documents? Briefly name and describe each component, determine their type (physical or logical), determine  how they are connected, and how they achieve the requirements.

question2.description: What solutions (e.g., patterns or tactics) are implemented to support the performance quality attribute in Apache Tika for parsing documents? Mention the considered quality attributes and describe the solutions applied, and how they achieve the requirements.

question3.description: Which tools and technologies are integrated to achieve its performance requirement in Apache Tika for parsing documents? Mention the technologies and tools, their associated components, rationale, and how they achieve the requirements.
